solution: The 'Do you know?' box on the Nationalisation of Banks page states verbatim: "Prime Minister Indira Gandhi nationalised 14 banks on 19th July 1969", and lists all fourteen by name (Allahabad Bank ... Union Bank of India). The Fourth Five Year Plan paragraph repeats it: "14 major banks in the country were nationalised." The rival numbers are traps built on the same box's closing line, "In 1980, six more banks were nationalised" — 14 + 6 = 20, but that is a later, separate event, so 16 or 18 is never the 1969 figure.

The chapter says: "20-Point Programme : Prime Minister Indira Gandhi announced the 20-point programme on 1st July 1975 and resolved to make efforts towards rapidly becoming a developed nation." Nehru is tied in this chapter to the mixed economy and the 1950 Planning Commission, Lal Bahadur Shastri to the Green Revolution experiment, and P. V. Narasimha Rao to the 1991 New Economic Policy — none of them to the 20-point programme.
